measurement: MEASURED NMOS6502 instruction cycles for existing l2_interval only, captured main state, no DMA; no turret cover implementation
scope: 1024 world rows x 3 difficulties; shell-row mapping, X overlap, priority and caller overhead not included
extraWallCycles: Not measured; native margin feasibility must be proved before implementation
fallbackExtraCodeEstimate: 40–70 B including geometry/cell guard and shell retirement; unmeasured placement, no state expected

preferredUnimplementedOption.method: Test the two backing bytes already captured by turret shell publication, with a central-column guard. Current hull art is in columns 0..7 and 32..39; island drawing is central (9..30). Codes plus the column distinguish island cover from the firing hull.
preferredUnimplementedOption.cpuCyclesEstimate: Approximately 5 cycles for a blank fast path, 40–50 instruction cycles per two-cell shell classification, up to about 150 for three shells; not measured and excludes DMA
preferredUnimplementedOption.limitations: Requires proof for moving overlay backing and collision priority. Stops shells at islands only; firing hull must remain transparent to its own shells. Does not affect enemy shots. No implementation or native feasibility claim.

geometryFallback: The measured l2_interval resolver below can classify geometry if the captured-byte/column guard proves insufficient; its row mapping and overlap/caller work remain extra.
